fusions.name: Prismatic Ray
fusions.desc: Shifts your skin to the colour of raw arcana and fires a ray at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Shifting Mote
fusions.desc: A quick arcane strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance of [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun on the Mana
fusions.desc: Lies still and basks in ambient arcana: restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spent Power Mends
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
